name: Extracellular Vestibule Site (ECL2 / TM2 / TM7 Entrance)
mechanism: Positive Allosteric Modulation via 'Lid Effect'. Binds atop orthosteric OXT, slowing down its dissociation rate (k_off reduction) and selectively stabilizing agonist engagement.
subtype_divergence: High (ECL2 and TM1-TM2 loop show <35% sequence identity and 3.5 Å backbone shift vs V1aR/V1bR).
desensitization_mitigation: Ceiling effect: does not drive constitutive over-activation; preserves endogenous pulsatility.
recommended_modality: Small-molecule PAM (e.g. fused indoles / biaryl amides).

name: Extrahelical Lipid-Facing Site (TM4-TM5 / CNC 45o Cholesterol Pocket)
mechanism: Mimics endogenous cholesterol/CHS positive allosteric modulation. Deep hydrophobic cavity that allosterically couples to TM5 outward swing, locking OXTR in the high-affinity state.
subtype_divergence: Moderate-to-High (Outer-leaflet lipid-facing residue patterns differ across OXTR vs V2R/V1aR).
desensitization_mitigation: Conformational clamp with minimal GRK/arrestin recruitment bias.
recommended_modality: Lipophilic small molecules / steroid mimetics / lipid-conjugated scaffolds.

name: Intracellular Juxtamembrane Site (ICL2 / TM3-TM5-TM6 Interface)
mechanism: Direct intracellular stabilizer of Gq heterotrimer coupling. Selectively promotes Gq pathway activation while sterically hindering beta-arrestin scaffolding.
subtype_divergence: High (ICL2 and intracellular helical tips exhibit distinct electrostatic topologies across vasopressin family).

name: Core Divalent Cation Coordination Switch (Mg2+ / Zn2+ Network)
mechanism: Allosteric cation network essential for full OXTR activation. Single conserved residue determines cation dependency vs V1aR.
subtype_divergence: High in cation sensitivity (V1aR does not require Mg2+ for activation).
